review_scope: Independent visual structural review of exact supplied authoring evidence; no runtime acceptance

findings.subject: Source identity
findings.evidence: Source comparison shows long neck, flared mouth, rounded lower vessel and right loop handle. Registered v7 retains these defining features and avoids the donor beer label, cap and straight silhouette.

findings.subject: Hollow translucent glass
findings.evidence: Registered empty layer exposes the dark backdrop through the central body and neck, with brighter wall edges and a readable mouth opening. Filled layer retains the same shell and adds a distinct low liquid band.

findings.subject: Handle roots and containment
findings.evidence: Registered handle meets the right neck and upper-right shoulder without a visible gap. Liquid has a level top and remains inside the bottom vessel outline, including the color probe.

findings.subject: High-resolution root and shading polish
findings.evidence: Oblique stage-02 lower handle root ends in a bright rounded highlight that reads slightly like a tube tip; raw neutral image also has granular highlights. Registered view resolves the root into the shoulder and these details do not undermine the intended-size silhouette.
findings.action: No fix-now required for structural acceptance.

findings.subject: Intended-size readability
findings.evidence: The 16x24, 24x36 and 32x48 samples in registration-comparison preserve the long neck, low bulb and right handle. The smallest handle is faint but remains distinct; liquid color reads at the base.

limitations: Static authoring images establish visual structure only. Native content, sealing, palette and in-game delivery are outside this review.
